text:
sarah: FYI release v2.14.0 canary stuck — deploy-bot showing upload failure for the image layer. Need quick decision: rollback vs manual pin/promote?

deploy-bot: promo-hold: job 4382 failed -> artifact upload incomplete (partial blob). Retries exhausted. Logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/4382

tom: I can see registry has an open multipart upload. S3 returned 499 on the final part. Runner likely lost network mid-chunk.

elin: Can someone paste the exact error? I can't reach CI UI from here.

tom: log snippet:
```
ERROR: upload failed: PutObject - status 499
upload-id: 4f2a9b2c...
Bytes uploaded: 7340032/16777216
```
looks like the agent died during finalize.

prateek: Suggestion: pin to last-good image sha and promote manually to unblock the canary. Also abort any in-flight multipart uploads so deploy-bot doesn't loop.

luca: Agree. Manual promote is safer than a rollback unless we see DB migrations. sarah — can you get the last-good image sha?

sarah: running `cictl last-successful-image v2.14.0` now... got sha: `sha256:abc123def456`

deploy-bot: manual-promote requested by sarah. To proceed: promote image `sha256:abc123def456` -> tag `canary`.

tom: Two follow-ups: 1) schedule debug for uploader network flakiness during tomorrow's change window (09:00-11:00 PT), 2) add a short release-note entry about the manual pin.

elin: Are there DB migrations in this canary? If yes, a manual promote could be risky.

prateek: No DB migrations in this release. I'll abort the multipart upload now: `aws s3api abort-multipart-upload --bucket redwood-artifacts --key builds/v2.14.0/image --upload-id 4f2a9b2c...` and then clear leftover parts.

luca: :thumbsup: I'll draft the release-note blurb and the manual-promo PR on `release/canary` branch. sarah, want me to run the promote after you confirm?

sarah: Please go ahead and promote. Also tagging @oncall because deploy-bot was stuck ~40m and we should log this as a follow-up.

oncall: Acknowledged. I'll add an incident follow-up for uploader reliability and include network telemetry for the runner pool.

luca: Promo started: running `cictl promote --from-sha sha256:abc123def456 --to-tag canary`

deploy-bot: promote-success: tag `canary` now points to `sha256:abc123def456`. Canary rollout resumed.

sarah: Canary is green on the initial smoke tests. Manual pin worked — unblocking the release. I'll file a postmortem and link to the follow-up runbook for multipart-cleanup.

prateek: I'll keep monitoring registry for stray parts and alert if another partial upload appears.

luca: Thanks all — I'll push the release-note and mark the thread resolved. :sparkles:
